create_cfr_br_solver: create a CFR-BR solver instance for a 2-player sequential game with linear averaging and regret matching plus
run_cfr_br_iteration: run a single CFR-BR iteration to compute best responses and update player policies
compute_best_responses: compute each player's best response against the current policies of all other players
evaluate_and_update_policy: evaluate and update player policies using counterfactual regret minimization against best responses
summarize_cfr_br_algorithm: summarize the CFR-BR algorithm for computing approximate Nash policies in 2-player sequential games
